name: media_assets
description: A media item of a company: one uploaded image or video, its owning scope (the company or one branch), name and tags, inspected facts and the objects derived from it.
lifecycle: Created UPLOADING; a complete upload makes it PROCESSING; the processor makes it READY or REJECTED (final) or, after repeated internal failures, FAILED. READY and ARCHIVED alternate; deleting an ARCHIVED item without protected references makes it DELETED with a 30-day purge_after, from which it can return to ARCHIVED; purge or discarding an unusable upload makes it PURGED, clearing object references. Rows are kept for audit; no runtime deletion. See docs/project/media-library-design.md.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated immutable media item UUID.
Company that owns the item; immutable (tenant key).
Branch that owns the item; immutable.
columns.Null meaning: The item belongs to the whole company and every member who may view media sees it.

columns.Meaning: Display name chosen by members, the uploaded file name by default; never used as a path.
Lower-case organization labels, at most ten, sorted.
columns.Null meaning: Never null; an empty array means no tags.

columns.Meaning: IMAGE or VIDEO, fixed by the declared type.
Lifecycle state; see the table lifecycle.
Why inspection or conversion rejected the file, from a closed set of MEDIA_* reason codes.
Media type the uploader declared; it only admits the upload, the file signature decides.
Exact size the uploader declared; the upload must deliver exactly this many bytes.
Hash of the stored original upload.
columns.Null meaning: No complete upload is stored (still uploading, rejected or purged).

columns.Meaning: Hash of the display rendition that playlists and publications use.
columns.Null meaning: The item has no usable rendition (not ready, rejected, failed or purged).

columns.Meaning: Hash of the panel thumbnail.
columns.Null meaning: The item has no usable rendition (not ready, rejected, failed or purged).

columns.Meaning: Displayed width of the display rendition after orientation.
Displayed height of the display rendition after orientation.
Duration of a video.
columns.Null meaning: An image, or a video not inspected yet.

columns.Meaning: Whether the video's display rendition carries an audio track.
columns.Null meaning: An image, or a video not inspected yet.

columns.Meaning: Current processing step: probing, converting or verifying.
Conversion progress reported by FFmpeg, written at most every two seconds.
Processing attempts started; internal failures retry up to three attempts.
Instant until which one processor owns the item's processing.
Earliest instant the processor may claim the item.
Membership that created the item; historical attribution, not authority.
Principal that created the item, for per-person upload limits.
PostgreSQL-clock instant the item was created.
Instant the complete file was received.
Instant the item first became usable.
Instant of the latest archive.
Instant the item was moved to the trash.
Earliest instant the purge may remove a deleted item.
Instant the item's files were removed.
Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful member change.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((processing_attempts >= 0))
constraints.Purpose: Attempt counts never go below zero.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The owning branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, created_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The creating membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, display_sha256) REFERENCES media_objects(company_id, sha256) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The display rendition is an object of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An item belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, original_sha256) REFERENCES media_objects(company_id, sha256) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The original is an object of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, thumbnail_sha256) REFERENCES media_objects(company_id, sha256) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The thumbnail is an object of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The creator is a known principal.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((declared_size > 0))
constraints.Purpose: A declared size is positive.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((width IS NULL) OR (width > 0)) AND ((height IS NULL) OR (height > 0))))
constraints.Purpose: Dimensions are positive.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((original_sha256 IS NULL) OR (octet_length(original_sha256) = 32)) AND ((display_sha256 IS NULL) OR (octet_length(display_sha256) = 32)) AND ((thumbnail_sha256 IS NULL) OR (octet_length(thumbnail_sha256) = 32))))
constraints.Purpose: Object references are SHA-256 digests.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((name)::text = btrim((name)::text)) AND (char_length((name)::text) >= 1)))
constraints.Purpose: Names are stored trimmed and nonempty.

constraints.Physical definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraints.Purpose: Unique media item identity.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((processing_progress IS NULL) OR ((processing_progress >= 0) AND (processing_progress <= 100))))
constraints.Purpose: Progress is a percentage.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((status = 'PURGED'::"MediaStatus") = (purged_at IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: A purge instant is recorded exactly for purged items.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((status = 'REJECTED'::"MediaStatus") = (rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: A rejection reason exists exactly for rejected items.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((tags IS NOT NULL) AND (cardinality(tags) <= 10)))
constraints.Purpose: Tags are present and at most ten.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((status = 'DELETED'::"MediaStatus") = (purge_after IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: A purge instant exists exactly for items in the trash.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['UPLOADING'::"MediaStatus", 'REJECTED'::"MediaStatus", 'FAILED'::"MediaStatus", 'PURGED'::"MediaStatus"])) OR ((display_sha256 IS NULL) AND (thumbnail_sha256 IS NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Items that are not usable hold no renditions.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['READY'::"MediaStatus", 'ARCHIVED'::"MediaStatus", 'DELETED'::"MediaStatus"])) OR ((original_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (display_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (thumbnail_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (width IS NOT NULL) AND (height IS NOT NULL) AND (ready_at IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Ready, archived and deleted items keep all their objects and facts.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((version >= 1))
constraints.Purpose: Versions start at one.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((duration_ms IS NULL) OR ((kind = 'VIDEO'::"MediaKind") AND (duration_ms > 0))))
constraints.Purpose: Only videos have a positive duration.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_assets_company_created_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (company_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a company's items newest first with stable keyset pagination.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_assets_company_id_id_key ON public.media_assets USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key for references to media items.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_assets_company_status_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (company_id, status)
constraints.Purpose: Counts a company's open uploads and processing items for abuse limits.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_assets_display_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (company_id, display_sha256)
constraints.Purpose: Finds whether another item still references an object before it is deleted.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_assets_original_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (company_id, original_sha256)
constraints.Purpose: Finds whether another item still references an object before it is deleted.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_assets_processing_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (status, next_attempt_at)
constraints.Purpose: Finds items due for processing and expired uploads and trash.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_assets_thumbnail_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (company_id, thumbnail_sha256)
constraints.Purpose: Finds whether another item still references an object before it is deleted.
